title: Gaidai
summary: The term 'Gaidai' encompasses several references, including a surname and educational institutions, as well as an asteroid. Its relevance extends to various fields, including academia and astronomy.

sections.heading: Gaidai Surname
paragraphs: Gaidai is a surname that may be associated with individuals of [[ukrainian|Ukrainian]] descent or heritage, reflecting the diverse cultural background of [[ukraine|Ukraine]].

sections.heading: Educational Institutions
paragraphs: Kansai Gaidai University, located in Japan, is an institution of higher learning that may attract Ukrainian students interested in international studies.
Kansai Gaidai College serves as another educational establishment in Japan, contributing to the global network of institutions that may include Ukrainian scholars.
Kyoto Gaidai Nishi High School is a secondary educational institution in Japan, which may also host students from various countries, including Ukraine.
